On impact, both the link and the rotor have to be stopped, and the reflected rotor inertia grows as the square of the gear ratio: at 100 : 1 it is ${fmtN(A.props(100).refl / A.props(6).refl)} times larger than at 6 : 1. That’s why legged robots, which hit the ground on every step, choose a small gear ratio. But a small gear ratio also means little torque. Can you get both?

Подходят только 12 : 1 и 15 : 1. При мен: Only 12 : 1 and 15 : 1 work. With a smaller gear ratio the motor lacks torque; with a larger one the reflected rotor inertia grows, and the landing impact with it. Real legs solve the same problem with a stronger motor, so a smaller gear ratio is enough for them: Mini Cheetah has 6 : 1 and up to 17 N·m at the output, MIT Cheetah 3 has 7.67 : 1 and 230 N·m. What remains is to feel the backdrivability of a small gearbox with your own hand.

Звено 100 : 1 стоит, пока усилие руки ме: The 100 : 1 link stays put while your hand’s torque is below the gearbox friction, ${fmt1(A.props(100).coul, 1)} N·m. Move your finger past the mark and wait: the link will creep along.
Звено 6 : 1 дошло до отметки за <b>${fmt: The 6 : 1 link reached the mark in ${fmt1(a || 0, 1)} s, and the 100 : 1 link in ${fmt1(b || 0, 1)} s. The 6 : 1 link starts moving at just ${fmt1(A.props(6).coul, 2)} N·m, while the 100 : 1 link needs ${fmt1(A.props(100).coul, 1)} N·m, and after that it is held back by the gearbox’s viscous friction and the reflected rotor inertia: both grow as the square of the gear ratio. That is backdrivability: through a small gearbox your hand easily turns the motor. The reverse is also true: the motor "feels" your hand, and its current tells you how hard you push. This is called actuator transparency. A backdrivable actuator yields to a push, while an actuator with a large gearbox holds its pose rigidly and barely notices the push.

Через 10 секунд гироскоп ушёл от настоящ: After 10 seconds the gyroscope has strayed ${fmt1(r.gyroEnd, 0)}° from the true angle. The zero offset is only 1.5 °/s, but when you add it up step by step, it keeps accumulating. That’s drift. The accelerometer doesn’t drift, but its mean error is ${fmt1(r.acc, 1)}°: noise and body jolts. The filter at α = 0.5 has a mean error of ${fmt1(r.filt, 1)}°, better than either sensor, but it still trusts the noisy accelerometer too much. How much should you trust each sensor?
На каждом шаге фильтр сдвигает оценку по: At each step the filter advances the estimate by the gyroscope and nudges it slightly toward the accelerometer angle. The gyro weight is α; the rest comes from the accelerometer. Move the slider and find an α at which the filter’s mean error is below 1.6°.
Гироскопу стоит верить почти полностью,: Trust the gyroscope almost completely, but not entirely: at α = 1 the drift comes back. Try values from 0.95 to 0.99.
При α&nbsp;=&nbsp;${alphaTxt(r.alpha)} с: At α = ${alphaTxt(r.alpha)} the mean error is ${fmt1(r.filt, 1)}°. The filter takes fast motion from the gyroscope and the slow "which way is down" from the accelerometer, so drift doesn’t accumulate and noise gets smoothed out. This is a complementary filter. At α = 0.98 and a 10 ms step, it pulls toward the accelerometer in about half a second. Its optimal version is the Kalman filter, the topic of Lesson 0.4. What if someone starts pushing the robot?
Робота толкают в бок: появляются коротки: The robot gets pushed from the side, causing short jolts. Each press adds four jolts, up to three times. The goal: keep the filter’s mean error under 2° even while shaking.
чья оценка пострадает от рывков сильнее: whose estimate will suffer the most from the jolts?
The filter is off by ${fmt1(r.filt, 1)}°. Check α: under shaking, the accelerometer deserves less trust.
Рывки подняли среднюю ошибку акселеромет: The jolts raised the accelerometer’s mean error from ${fmt1(r.acc0, 1)}° to ${fmt1(r.acc, 1)}°, while the filter barely noticed them: ${fmt1(r.filt, 1)}°. The gyroscope doesn’t see the jolts at all: it measures rotation, not acceleration. The filter takes only the slow component from the accelerometer, so short jolts hardly get through. Чем больше передаточное число, тем лучше: Is a bigger gear ratio always better because it gives more torque?
Нет: растут инерция, трение и сила удара: No: inertia, friction and impact force all grow
Инерция ротора на выходе растёт как квад: Reflected rotor inertia grows as the square of the gear ratio. That’s why legged robots use a small gear ratio in their legs.
Камер достаточно, остальные сенсоры лишн: Are cameras enough, so that other sensors are unnecessary?
Да, если камер больше трёх: Yes, if there are more than three cameras
Камера даёт 30–90 кадров в секунду и не: A camera gives 30–90 frames per second and can’t see contact when the fingers cover the object. An IMU delivers data at up to 2 kHz, the ATI Axia80 force sensor at up to 8 kHz.
Нейросеть управляет моторами напрямую?: Does the neural network control the motors directly?
Обычно нет: она выдаёт цели на 10–200 Гц: Usually not: it outputs targets at 10–200 Hz, and the motors are driven by controllers running at around a kilohertz
Нет, нейросети не используют в управлени: No, neural networks aren’t used in control
Например, RL-политика Mini Cheetah выдаё: For example, the Mini Cheetah RL policy outputs 12 target angles at 50 Hz, while the PD controllers on the motor drivers run at up to 40 kHz. Policies that output torques directly are rare.
Симулятор точно повторяет привод?: Does the simulator reproduce the actuator exactly?
Да, если физика точная: Yes, if the physics is accurate
Нет: задержки, трение и люфт — частый ис: No: latency, friction and backlash are a common source of mismatch
Нет, но разница всегда незаметна: No, but the difference is always negligible
В лаборатории идеальная модель ошибалась: In the lab the ideal model erred six times more than the network trained on actuator data. And with 40 ms latency its error grew to 8.4°.
Степеней свободы столько же, сколько мот: Are there as many degrees of freedom as motors?
Не всегда: в кисти Optimus 2022 года 6 п: Not always: the 2022 Optimus hand has 6 actuators for 11 degrees of freedom
Тросы и связанные механизмы позволяют од: Tendons and coupled mechanisms let one motor move several joints.
IMU сразу даёт точный угол наклона?: Does an IMU give an accurate tilt angle right away?
Нет: гироскоп дрейфует, акселерометр шум: No: the gyroscope drifts and the accelerometer is noisy, so the two are combined
Только если IMU дорогой: Only if the IMU is expensive
Даже маленькое смещение нуля гироскопа п: Even a small gyroscope zero offset accumulates when integrated. A complementary filter or a Kalman filter combines the strengths of both sensors.
Без датчика силы робот не знает силу кон: Can a robot without a force sensor know the contact force?
Знает приблизительно: при малом передато: Roughly: with a small gear ratio, force is estimated from motor current
MIT Cheetah оценивает силу в ноге по ток: MIT Cheetah estimates leg force from motor current. The price is error: in Cheetah 3, gearbox friction adds about ±10%.
Пружина в приводе только мешает точности: Does a spring in an actuator only hurt precision?
Да, поэтому в приводах роботов пружин не: Yes, that’s why robot actuators have no springs
Нет: пружина смягчает удары, а по её сжа: No: the spring softens impacts, and the actuator measures force from its compression
Пружина нужна только для того, чтобы зап: A spring is only needed to store energy for jumps
Так устроен серийно-упругий привод: в но: That’s how a series elastic actuator works: ANYmal has twelve of them in its legs. The price: force changes more slowly, because the spring has to compress first.
AS5047P в Mini Cheetah — 14 бит, но окол: the AS5047P in Mini Cheetah has 14 bits, but about 2 of them are noise; G1 has two encoders per joint: on the rotor and at the output
Ада ездит на колёсной базе: моторы крутя: Ada drives on a wheeled base: motors turn the wheels, and encoders count their revolutions.
Нет: камера медленная и не видит контакт: No: the camera is slow and can’t see contact, while balance and grasping need an IMU, encoders and force sensors
В каждом суставе мотор с редуктором и эн: Each joint has a motor with a gearbox and an encoder that measures the angle. This is where the policy’s commands arrive.
Цепочка над этим окном — путь команды. Э: The chain above this panel is the path of a command. An encoder is a joint angle sensor; the IMU senses the body’s tilt and rotation. A joint controller, usually PD or PID, compares the target angle with the measured one and computes how much torque the motor should produce; Lesson 0.3 covers it in detail. The current loop inside the motor delivers that torque. Hz means times per second, kHz thousands of times per second.
